name: command-watchdog
description: Supervise Codex shell commands at lowest CPU priority and stop idle, overlong, or orphaned tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Supervise shell tasks at lowest CPU priority.
interface.longDescription: Wrap Codex shell and exec_command calls with the shared command watchdog. Stream output, preserve command exit status, and stop tasks when output and CPU stop progressing, their parent exits, or a configured runtime cap expires. Requires process permissions for priority changes and supervision; restricted macOS execution can return 125 without starting the task.
